The small orange spheres have a uniform, plastic-like smoothness that contrasts with the rougher texture of the pan. They lack distinct stems or natural imperfections, looking like generated blobs.
The metallic object in the upper background has warped reflections and an ambiguous shape, making it difficult to identify as a specific kitchen item.
